en:
That day was supposed to be just
another peaceful day of sailing through
the sea of stars, with nothing out of
the ordinary happening... or so it
seemed.
...Captain! Wake up, Captain!

Are you surprised by this sight? While
the Captain was napping in their seat,
the scenery inside the ship suddenly
changed!
No, it's not just the scenery.\nUm... our clothes have changed\nlike this, too.

Holy cow, everyone's in
swimsuits! Everything, every
single thing has turned into
swimsuits!
Edge, you pervert! Don't get\nexcited at a time like this!

Getting excited over something like
this... you boys are so cute. As for me, I
don't think this is much different from
what I usually wear.

Setting the outfits aside, why are we in
this state...? Could it be that the walls
were repainted and our clothes were
changed in an instant...?
Of course not. This scenery\nand our outfits are the result\nof advanced spatial projection.

You can't see the ship's walls or your
original clothes... but look, you can still
feel them, right? It's a hologram... no,
it's closer to a Battle Simulator.

Oh, you're right. I can feel my
original clothes... My hand
passes right through Myuria's
waist cloth... it's just an illusion.

Now, Captain, surely you can
understand spatial projection without
having to actually touch things? Stop
groping around. ...That goes for you too,
Edge.
Hmph!
I wasn't "excited" or anything!\nThis is a total frame-up! Right,\nCaptain?

A frame-up? Does this mean
you prefer wet swimsuits? I
didn't realize preferences were
so specific on Earth...!
N-no, that's not it...! At this\nrate, my reputation is just\ngoing to keep tanking!

If this is a spatial projection, I
think the cause is a glitch in
the Battle Simulator. Let's
hurry and go check it out.
Ow! I ran into something!
Edge! I can't see it, but that's\nprobably a wall. The door is\nthis way...!
Ouch... My eyes are swimming.\nIt's dangerous if I don't feel my\nway around. Uh, is this...?
E-Edge! That's my...!
Whoa, sorry Clair! But it\ndefinitely doesn't feel like skin,\nso this is safe...!
Like that's allowed! Edge, you\npervert!

T-true, in this situation... if we
don't hurry, Edge's reputation
will only continue to
deteriorate...

It looks like the hallways and all
the other rooms have turned
into a beach. The area of
effect is quite extensive.
Yeah... and it seems like\neveryone is enjoying this\nsituation more than I expected.
Yay! It's been forever since I've\nbeen to the beach! This feels\ngreat!
I wonder if there's a beach\nshack! You know, the kind that\nsells yakisoba and parfaits!
Miki, Millie! We don't even know\nwhat's going on, this is no time\nto be fooling around!

For someone saying that, you sure look
like you're having fun chasing after
them, Rena. And Miki and Millie are
completely caught up in the excitement.

Besides, how can you all be so
happy while dressed in such
embarrassing outfits? Is this
normal for you people!?

...They really are enjoying themselves.
But they have such lovely smiles. I'm
just glad they aren't feeling sadness or
pain. That's a relief.

Still, the imagery is so precise.
Projecting this across the entire ship
would require an incredibly advanced
simulation. The only thing capable of
this would be...
It's probably the Battle\nSimulator. It has the largest\nsimulation capacity on the ship.
But even so, this projection\nrange is absurd. Something\nmust be going on. ...Let's hurry!
The room with the simulator\nshould be around here. Now\nthen, the door is...
Huh? The door opened from\nthe other side...?

Oh? I thought it was getting
noisy out there. If it isn't the
Captain and the others! You've
arrived already!

Now, now, no need for thanks.
If you were surprised and
enjoyed it, then all my hard
work modifying it was worth it!
You mean... you're the one who\ncreated this situation, Verda!?
Indeed! I just tweaked the\nBattle Simulator a tiny bit...

...No, I shouldn't brag. With
Coro's help, I worked very hard
to project this beach across
the entire ship!

My... I am surprised. But, how
should I put this... while I
admire the effort, it's a bit
much.
Uh... well...

Huh? What's this? Everyone's reaction
isn't what I expected... I thought
everyone would be overjoyed to be at
the open sea!

Ha! Are you worried that I
broke the Battle Simulator?
Don't be! Its original functions
are still perfectly intact!
Here, give it a try! It can still\nspawn enemies just fine!

I see, so the Battle Simulator's core
functions haven't changed. You just
made it possible to project the beach
and the outfits across the entire ship.
I don't know the technical\ndetails, but Verda's skill is truly\nimpressive. I'm amazed...
Still, doing this without\nconsulting anyone first... this is\nmore than just a prank, Verda.
...Hmm, judging by everyone's\nreaction, it seems I may have\nmisread the room...?
The truth is...
To recreate last year's beach?
To help everyone blow off\nsome steam?
To grow tropical bananas!

As expected of the Captain, you've
seen right through me. Tika was
muttering about how "last year's beach
was so much fun."

I couldn't join in back then
because of another matter, so
I got a bit overzealous about
making this summer special!

Well, a lot of heavy things have been
happening lately. I thought seeing a
wide, blue ocean would be a good
change of pace for everyone.

Tika had just been telling everyone
about last year's beach, and the little
ones said they wanted to go to the
ocean too.

Right, right. I thought I'd cultivate some
tropical bananas―perfect for eating or
as gifts―and make them the star of our
interstellar trade...

Wait, as if that would actually
work! Just how much do I love
bananas?! Well, I do love them,
but still!
...Regardless, I should have\nconsulted you first, Captain.\nMy apologies.

I'd like to stop this immediately,
but Coro is the only one who
knows the code to cancel the
ship-wide projections.
That rascal went off somewhere looking\nquite pleased with himself after he\nfinished modifying the simulator.
I see... Hmm, I think I could\nforce the simulator to stop, but\nI might end up breaking it.

Oh, in that case, perhaps we
don't need to force it to stop?
This is actually quite lovely; I'd
like to enjoy it for a while.

Coro will likely return soon enough, so it
should be fine to leave it like this for a
bit. Since we're here, why don't you
take a little break too, Captain?
All right! Serve it, girls! Here\ngoes!
Got it! Receive! Sophia, you're\nup!
All right! Secret Technique!\nLightning Spike!
Awaaaa!? I can't get it!
Leave it to me! Spinning\nReceive!

Clair, you were the one who negotiated
with the Captain to let us keep this sea
and beach. It was a good call. Everyone
seems to be having a great time.

With people coming and going, and
some taking different paths... I feel like
it's been a long time since I've seen
such bright smiles.

The Captain was exhausted,
and I simply wanted those of
you in leadership positions to
have a chance to rest as well.
Why don't you relax in a beach\nchair, Maria, until Coro comes\nout?
True... though you seem quite\nat home here yourself. You're\nremarkably relaxed.

Phew! I really swam my heart out! Man,
I love the ocean! They say it's an
illusion, but I can't tell it apart from the
real thing.

It feels great to ride the waves for the
first time in a while. For some reason,
being with Lati helps me stay
disciplined with my exercise, which is a
huge help.

Ah... Edge, you do tend to get
caught up in weird accidents.
Especially when there's not
much fabric in your clothes.
Yeah... that happened this time\ntoo... Well, anyway, never mind\nthat.
Since we're here, I want to get\na bit more exercise. What\nshould I do...?

Oh, Edge! If that's the case, how about
some combat training under this vast
sea and sky? The sense of openness is
completely different!
Oh, that sounds great! I'm in.
Very well! I shall summon some\nenemies that fit this waterfront\nsetting! Come forth!

Haha, it feels a bit strange to
do combat training on the
beach with everyone here, but
it's a lot of fun!

It's so wide open, the feeling is
completely different. The sea
breeze feels great against my
skin after working up a sweat!

Clair! I've given it a try myself, and it is
truly excellent. It seems there are new
weapons included; would you like to join
me?

Thank you, Nel. I appreciate
the invitation, but... I want to
forget about fighting today, so
I'll pass.
Just watching Nel enjoy herself\nin battle here is happiness\nenough for me. Hehe...

It feels so weird seeing special moves
flying around right next to people
playing with a beach ball... though it is
quite refreshing to watch.

Hey, Verda. Are those enemies and
everyone's techniques all just illusions
made by the simulator? Can you make
other illusions too?

Hmm, I've only prepared this beach for
the background, but as for people and
enemies, I can project them all,
including their techniques...

Just as I did with your swimwear, I can
use the people and enemies as screens
and project different clothes or forms
over them... in other words, overlay the
projection.

I received the data for everyone's
swimwear from Coro, after all. For
example, I could project a precise
image of Rena's swimwear onto an
enemy.

Whoa, so all the enemies would
become Rena? I'd kind of like
to see that. Would their moves
become Rena's too?
They would. This is, after all,\nstill the Battle Simulator. Here,\nlet me show you.
Ah, wa-wait a second...!
Wha-?! There's another me...!?
Whoa, that's amazing. You can't\neven tell them apart just by\nlooking.

W-wait, am I really wearing
something that daring!? Seeing
it from the front like this is so
embarrassing...
Oh, it's fine. It's white and\nsimple, so it looks healthy. I\nthink it's perfect for training.

I agree, it's just right for
training. Since we're at it, I
might actually want to spar
with this Rena.
Y-you think so...? Well, if you\nsay so...

Hmm, it's hard to fight an
enemy with my own face... But
sparring might be useful for
learning my own weaknesses...
...Hehe.
Hey there, Captain! Why don't\nwe do something naughty?
W-what was that?! I would\nnever say something like that!
Oh? My, how strange.

It is merely wearing Rena's appearance,
so its thoughts and actions should not
have changed... In fact, it should not
even be able to speak.
Captain... I looooove you...!
Whoa, it's attacking! Everyone,\nintercept! ...Though, I might be\na little jealous of the Captain.
What on earth are you thinking,\nEdge?!
Don't get in my waaaaay!\nSplayed Shaver!
Whoa! This thing is strong!
I-I have to protect the Captain\nand my own dignity! Everyone,\nplease help me!
Aahn, how cruel... I just wanted\nto give the Captain a big, tight\nhug...
Stop doing things like that\nwhile looking like me! What if\npeople get the wrong idea!

W-what in the world is
happening? Did the enemy AI
break? I don't believe I
tinkered with it that much...

I've been watching for a while
now, and that fake Rena-chan's
behavior... doesn't it seem a bit
like Coro-kun?

Ha... now that you mention it! I
think Coro was messing with
the enemy AI "so the Captain
could have some fun"!

...I see. He programmed the AI
to be affectionate toward the
Captain if it was generated in a
swimsuit.
I don't appreciate that.
Classic Coro, he knows just\nwhat I like!
So Clair was just watching?

Ho ho, as expected of our Captain.
Such a gentlemanly response. You
know, it wouldn't hurt to be a bit more
honest, like Edge.

I'm being framed, Verda! I
wouldn't want an AI like that! If
Reimi saw me being hugged by
Rena...
Hmm...?
You actually like that kind of\nthing, Captain!? I can't believe\nit!
I can see why Rena is so\nupset. I wonder if all men are\nlike this...
*Sigh*... thank you for\nunderstanding. You have it\nhard too, don't you, Reimi?

Yes, I decided in my heart to
truly relax on this vacation... so
I simply watched the spectacle
for my own amusement.
So that's what happens when a\nnormally serious professional\nactually tries to take a break...

Yes, the power gap wasn't so
great that it was a losing
battle... Ah, I can't help but
analyze things. Hehe.
Ugh... I know Coro was just\ntrying to entertain the Captain,\nbut this is going too far!

I've had a wonderful time on
this vacation, but... Coro's
blunder is still a blunder, and it
requires punishment. Hehe.
...Clair, hasn't your vibe been a\nbit different lately? Are you\nstill half-asleep...?
Ah! Look out, everyone! That's\nnot the Clair we know!
What?! Don't tell me... is she\nanother one of Coro's AIs?!

No! I let her try out the "Whip"
that was added to the
simulator, and she took a
strange liking to it...

Hehe... A little vacation, a little
escape from the everyday. I
think it's time for some...
punishment, don't you?

...Perhaps it is the freedom of
a vacation, but something that
should have remained locked
has been unleashed.

Or maybe something that
should have stayed dormant
has awakened... She and Coro
might actually get along.
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! Clair\nisn't usually like this...
Hehe... Coro needs punishment\ntoo, but Verda, you're quite the\naccomplice, aren't you?
Come here so I can punish you.\nAnd anyone who gets in my\nway gets punished too!
Ah, waaaah! Everyone, retreat!

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
...Ah. What on earth was I\ndoing?

Phew... It seems you've come
to your senses now that the
whip projection is gone. That
was a close one.

To think a single whip could
change you so drastically.
Have you been under that
much stress lately?

It seems I've shown you a rather
embarrassing side of myself... But I'm
not under much stress. Not since the
war ended.

If anything, life on this ship is
so enjoyable and the ocean is
so liberating... I may have just
let myself go a bit too far.

I see, well that's good. It makes
all the hard work Coro and I
put into the modifications
worth it.
Now then, perhaps I'll enjoy the\nocean a bit myself. Will you join\nme, Clair?
Ah, Big Sister Verda! This\nocean is so much fun! Thank\nyou!
Oh, Tika! I'm glad to see you're\nhaving such a great time!
Hello, Clair! Since we're here,\nwhy don't you come swim with\nus?
Thank you for the invite, Tika.\nI'd love to. What about you,\nVerda?
Swim... huh? I appreciate the\noffer, but I... well...

Oh! Verda, is that floaty your
own handmade creation? To
make one that big... wait, don't
tell me you can't swim...

Gaaaah! It can't be helped! I
grew up in a lab in a snowy
country! I've only ever seen the
ocean in books!

Well, that's how it is. I plan to
fully enjoy just floating around
on my floaty, so you two go
ahead and enjoy your swim.
...Tika. I don't know Verda very\nwell, so I just want to make\nsure...

...She isn't just holding back
because she's being
considerate of us and actually
wants to play, is she?

No, I think she's fine. If she really
wanted to play... or rather, swim with
us, she's the type of person who would
just whip something up in a flash.

Right now, she's probably just
keeping her distance because
she's hoping that Clair and I
will become close.

I feel like Clair and I have similar
positions within our organizations, but
we haven't had many chances to talk
until now.
That is true. My, my... Verda is\nfar more intelligent and\nthoughtful than she lets on.

I wonder if I was that considerate of
others when I was her age. I only
remember frolicking on my father's
shoulders whenever we went to the
sea.
Tika, you... you didn't get to\nhave a typical childhood, did\nyou?
Hmm, now that you mention it,\nmaybe not. Does that bother\nyou?

The infinite sea of stars, the eternal
flow of time... when you drift within
them, you can't help but be bewildered
by the differences in everyone's
backgrounds.

Elicoor came from a land of
war, but I spent my own
childhood blessed with a
wealthy home...

I suppose I feel a sense of
guilt, or perhaps a feeling that
my perspective is out of sync
with everyone else's.

Your father, Adray, was a high-ranking
official of the state, too. I imagine being
on the side of the ruling class for
generations comes with its own set of
burdens and worries.
But Clair, you don't need to\nlook like that while you're on\nthis ship.

Everyone on this crew, including me
and Verda, carries a different past.
We're a "family" who can understand
one another.

...Tika. You may be right. I'll
keep those feelings as they
are, and instead focus on
everyone I'm living with now...

Exactly! It'd be a waste to spend your
time looking troubled in a vast ocean
like this! Come on, let's swim! You're a
good swimmer, right?

Hehe... thank you. That's right,
my father trained me quite
rigorously, so I can hold my
own against most people.

Ho ho. Now that's a beautiful
sight, seeing you two get along.
And you both have a fine
swimming form.
Even with this floaty I've customized, I\ncan't keep up with them. After all, this\nis my first time even entering the sea.

Listening to their excited voices while
leaving the buoyancy and propulsion to
my floaty... just drifting along and
enjoying the ocean... this is paradise.
...Hm? What's this? My floatie\nis suddenly shaking...
...Nuuuugh!? S-stop moving on\nyour own! Where are you taking\nme?!

...Oh? Verda is certainly
energetic. It looks like her
swimming has suddenly
improved...

N-no, it's not! The floatie is just
running wild! W-we have to
catch her! It'll be terrible if
she's carried out to sea!

Ah, I know that feeling! It's alright. When
I rode on my father while he was
swimming, he once took me all the way
to the next continent...
T-that is clearly far beyond the\nnorm! Anyway, let's go after\nher together!

Phew... I never thought I'd be betrayed
by a floatie of my own making. I wish
the rebellion of one's creations stayed
in the realm of fiction.
That was a close call, Verda\nKleiman. I lent a small hand in\nyour rescue as well.
Ugh... my apologies. Thank you\nfor the trouble, Mastima.

Are you enjoying the sea as
well? Not that I'm one to talk,
but you shouldn't spend all
your time cooped up in a lab.
Lab? What do you mean?

Well, haven't you been
completely stuck with your
research on Summoning Sigil
Arts lately?

Was I? In any case, I don't
have time to fuss over such
things now. The most important
thing right now is―yes!
Managing the beach house,\n<font color=yellow>Ocean House Hot & Cool</font>, of\ncourse!
Wh-what?! Since when has a\nvideo of a shop been projected\nhere?!

Eat up and get a spicy kick!
We've added a divine-grade
upgrade to the flaming <font color=yellow>Hot
Yakisoba</font> this year!

Fruits scattered like jewels through the
skill of a professional patissier. Be
captivated by new flavors and brilliance
with this year's new creation, the
<font color=yellow>Eleven-Berry Parfait</font>!

And then, top that parfait with
the finest farm-fresh vanilla ice
cream... Now, lose yourselves in
the trinity of taste!

I-I don't know about this! I never
created a shop like this in the
simulator. And what's wrong with you
people? Your personalities have
completely changed!!

Hmph... could it be that they're all
products of some strange AI, just like
Rena? Maybe I pushed the simulator
too hard and it's glitching...

Hey now, what's the deal? You
saying you can't eat the stuff
we made? This year's
customers are real cold.

And here we were, using every ounce
of our skill to provide special hospitality
for this season. You truly are a little
girl who doesn't understand the value
of things.
No... perhaps the spiciness of\nthe Hot Yakisoba is simply too\nterrifying for a small child.

What if we piled cream and
vanilla ice cream onto the
yakisoba... yes, piled it high like
a mountain?
Wait, wait! It's one thing for the\nprogram to glitch, but don't let\nyour taste buds glitch too!
H-hm. Doing such a thing would\nbe like buying a one-way ticket\nto a tour of hell, would it not?

But I want to know what it
would taste like... I want to
experiment... freely, without
interference.

Well said! That infinite Academic
Thirst―as expected of the owner of the
rival shop that used to give us such a
headache!

Exactly, you can't know the taste until
you try it! Alright, if we just dump this
parfait on top, it'll all fit! Here it comes,
BAM!
Gwaaaah! Stop this heresy! To\njust sloppily pile things on top\nof my work of art...!

Oh, a wonderful creation! Ice
cream, cream, and even
berries! Now, time for the taste
test!

Th-this is...! Even after living for 3.7
billion years, I have never experienced a
flavor like this! Something... something
is awakening!
It's... it's delicious~~!
Ooooooh~!
Unbelievable! Did such an\nintense flavor actually draw out\nher true power?!

She's spitting plasma from her
mouth! At this rate, not just
the beach house, but the whole
beach is gonna vanish!
...A-a-ahhh! Mastima, don't look\nthis way! Someone, help me~!
...H-huh? Am I still alive? I'm\npretty sure I was blown away\nby Mastima...?
No, wait, was I just napping?\n...Was all that just a dream...?
That was a close call, Verda\nKleiman. You seemed to be\nhaving quite the nightmare.
Nuoh, Mastima?! Since when\nwere you there...?! Don't tell me\nthat dream was...
N-no. I'll stop questioning it.\nDreams and virtual realities\nmust never become reality.

Attention everyone who
ordered water guns for playing
in the water! They're finished,
so I've come to deliver them!

Heave-ho... Phew, that's a lot of
them. Are these actual physical
objects and not just simulation
products?
Hehehe! That just shows how\npopular my technology is!

Making them fun because
they're water guns, yet keeping
them realistic! Balancing both
is where my skill truly shines!
Wow, they all look so\nwell-made! As expected of Big\nSister Welch!
Hmm, so this part goes here,\nand you press this to spray\nthe water. Let's see...
Wha―glub!
Oops, sorry Welch! It went off\nby accident.

Hehehe... Eu and I already
changed into real swimsuits
just in case this happened, so
it's no problem!
But I'm fighting back! Take this!\nWelch's Lethal Weapon\nHydraulic Blaster!
Whoa!
Welch, what on earth is that?!\nThat's not a water gun\nanymore, it's a water cannon!
Hehe. That's what you call a\nvictory for technology!

Welch!! When did you even
build a weapon like that?!
You're going to hurt someone if
you use it!
You're exaggerating. I made it\nso I could adjust the output.\nSee, if I set this button to low...
Kyaaaa!! I'm being swept away!!
Tika, are you okay?! Welch, is\nthat thing even safe?! The\noutput clearly just increased!

W-well, this much should be fine, right?
I mean, you're all trained! If we use this
for water play, it'll be like extra training
for everyone!

Even if we're trained, it'll still hurt if we
get hit by a blast with that much force.
You can't use something like that for
playing.
B-but, I made this all by myself\nfrom the blueprints up! I really\nwant to try it out.
Just once! Just once, as a test\nrun, I want to play with Eu and\nthe others...
Hmm...

Welch. It'll be too late once
someone gets hurt. Let's use
these mass-produced water
guns instead.
These are your work too, aren't\nthey, Welch? I think they\nturned out great.
Fine.
I can't believe Big Sister Welch\ngave in so easily... Big Brother\nEuwin is amazing.

Well, we've known each other
for a long time. I'm just relieved
we can avoid any casualties
from Welch's weapons.

With weapons Welch builds from
scratch, there's always the risk they'll
suddenly malfunction and Welch herself
will go up in a huge explosion...
Hmm... I suppose that's not\nentirely impossible... Though\nWelch probably...
...Eu. Are you trying to say that\neverything I build is a piece of\njunk?!

N-no, that's not what I meant!! But
there have been dangerous machines,
right? Every time I've been a guinea
pig, it's always been a failure...

Not always!! It's only every
once in a while that they get a
tiny bit glitchy and completely
disintegrate!
Disintegrating is definitely a\nproblem...

...Grrr. In the first place, why do
you think I put so much effort
into the trial and error of
making these weapons...
Why? Because tinkering with\nmachines is your hobby, right?
That's it! This is a duel, Eu-bo!\nI'm going to beat you to a pulp\nwith Welch's Lethal Weapon!
Wait, you said you weren't\ngoing to use that weapon!
It's fine! This time, you're my\nonly target, Eu-bo! I won't let\nanyone else get hurt!
Now, hurry up and grab that\nwater gun, Eu-bo!
...I don't think I can talk her\ndown this time.

Oh no, even Big Brother Euwin
couldn't stop her... Hey, Big
Sister Verda, is it really okay
to just leave them alone!?
Hmm? Well, once things get to\nthat point, it's just rude for an\noutsider to step in.

Besides, Welch has a dream
she refuses to give up on,
doesn't she? Though she is far
too clumsy about it.
Eh? A dream...?
Hm, what is it, Rena? When did\nyou get there...?
...Wet swimsuit. Good.
Waaaah!? W-what's going on all\nof a sudden? Why are there so\nmany weird Renas!?

What in the world is
happening?! Did those strange
AIs I thought I'd suppressed
reappear?! No... this is...
Wet swimsuit, good! I shall take\nthem back and present them\nto the Captain!
Hyaaaaah! Hey, where are you\ntouching...! Awawawawa~!
Ah! Welch is being kidnapped?!
This is bad! The simulator is\nrunning wild!
Wet swimsuits! I am taking\nthem all!
Welch, I'll push the enemies\nback from here, so use the\nopening to escape!
Thanks! Here I go! Take this!\nHydraulic Blaster!
Gyaaah!
Phew... thanks, Eu! You saved\nme!
Big sister Welch and Eu are so\nin sync! They look so cool!

A fine combination, the two of
you. As the creator, she
certainly knows how to handle
a water gun!
My swimsuit... my soaked\nswimsuit...
But this is never-ending! What\nare we supposed to do!

The modifications may have
put too much strain on the
Battle Simulator, causing it to
overheat.

You are the only ones capable of
